Messages.Author: Mark Lamutt
Messages.Body:
Card text for the Jyhad version says "during your untap phase you may
collect 1 blood from his or her blood pool."
Card text for the VTES version says "During each
of his or her untap phases, you can collect 1 pool
from that Methuselah."

Which untap phase can the 1 pool be collected?

Mark
